title: Batman and the missing lights.
lines: In the city of Gotham it's getting dark.
High on a roof someone is standing.
He has a black cape and a mask with pointy ears.
He's strong because he trains every day.
And he has a belt full of handy things.
A rope, a torch and a magnifying glass.
During the day Batman is just Bruce.
He lives in a big house.
His friend Alfred looks after him.
Every evening Alfred makes warm soup.
Under the house there's a secret cave.
And that's where the Batmobile is.
All the lights have gone out in the big hospital.
It's pitch dark in the hospital.
With his magnifying glass he finds something.
I know who did this, says Batman.
Batman follows the ice trail to an old factory.
He has taken all the lamps.
Why did you steal the lights?
I can only live in the cold.
He doesn't want to hurt Mister Freeze.
He wants to solve the problem.
Mister Freeze is nice and cold again.
He gives back all the lamps.
The lights come back on in the hospital.
The children wave at the window.
Above the city shines a light with a bat in it.
